    Class TpNumberfield

    numeric field with an optional native range slider.

    Example

    <tp-numberfield label="Quantity" value="3" min="0" max="10" clearable></tp-numberfield>

    Tagname

    tp-numberfield

    Attr

    label = "" - Visible label associated with the native input.

    Attr

    label-position = "top" - Label position (top, bottom, start, or end).

    Attr

    aria-label = "" - Accessible name when a visible label is not supplied.

    Attr

    value = "" - Numeric value; range mode normalizes it to a nonempty value within its limits.

    Attr

    min = "" - Lower bound; native range inputs default to 0.

    Attr

    max = "" - Upper bound; native range inputs default to 100.

    Attr

    step = "1" - Positive numeric increment, or any for unrestricted fractional values.

    Attr

    name = "" - Name submitted with the containing form; defaults to the initial inline content when omitted.

    Attr

    list = "" - ID of an external datalist supplying numeric suggestions or slider tick marks.

    Attr

    placeholder = "" - Hint shown by the empty number input; ignored in range mode.

    Attr

    range = false - Uses input type range instead of input type number.

    Attr

    required = false - Requires a value in number mode; ignored by native range inputs.

    Attr

    readonly = false - Prevents editing; a readonly slider is disabled with a hidden submission mirror.

    Attr

    disabled = false - Disables editing, clearing and form submission.

    Attr

    clearable = false - Shows a button that empties a number or resets a slider to its native midpoint. input Emitted when the value changes during editing or clearing. change Emitted when the value is committed or cleared. tp-clear Emitted after clearing a number or resetting the slider.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-numberfield-inline-size=20ch] Width of the field.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-numberfield-background=var(--tp-paper-color)] Field background.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-numberfield-border-color=var(--tp-neutral-stroke-soft)] Field border color.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-numberfield-focus-color=var(--tp-brand-text-colorful)] Focus indicator color.
